notes.title: Achievements Live!!!
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.7 introduces 50 new achievements to The Last Archwing!!! Can you get them all?

Some of the Achievements are designed to help show players possibilities in the game that they didn't know about. Some of these revolve around game mechanics that the game doesn't tell you about in the tutorials, but since you've been kind enough to read this post, we'll share a couple of tips to help unlock some of the new Achievements!

Enemy Laser Reflection:
===================
Players can reflect lasers back at enemies to deal damage! There are 3 ways to do this. The Super Death Wave will reflect all enemy lasers away from the player. All lasers that hit the player while they are either barrel rolling, or invulnerable from picking up a rainbow capsule will also make lasers bounce off of the player's shield.

Barrel Roll Tips:
============
While the primary use of the barrel roll is defensively to avoid damage, it can also be used offensively to deal damage to enemies that are passed through. Increasing your "Special" upgrade levels will increase the damage the barrel roll deals to enemies. You can also use the barrel roll to pick up capsules, and as long as there's a capsule to pick up along your barrel roll route, you can roll indefinitely.

Happy hunting!
   - Archwing Entertainment

notes.title: V1.2.1 - V1.2.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We've been busy improving the game since the release of multiplayer (V1.2.0) and we're already up to V1.2.6! 

Below are the patch notes for all the balance changes, improvements, and bug fixes:

Version 1.2.1 Patch Notes
=========================
1) Changed multiplayer menu names to make more sense. Shortened remote play instructions.
2) Player names and meters now display during multiplayer tutorials.
3) Changed color of wingmate shields to dark green, so their color doesn't get confused with the second player (purple color).
4) There is now a confirmation prompt after selecting to return to the main menu during gameplay.
5) Increased volume of "Weapons Maxed!" and Resurrection sound effects.
6) Added the Sound menu option to all in-game menus. (Before was only available from main menu)
7) Fixed issue of wingmates getting jumbled when barrel rolling into a screen edge.

Version 1.2.2 Patch Notes
========================
1) Reduced asteroid health.
2) Increased minimum spawn time per asteroid in hard mode from 1s to 1.5s. (Fewer asteroids in hard mode).

Version 1.2.3 Patch Notes
========================
1) Player's super meter no longer gets cleared on death in single or multiplayer. Even resurrection will allow the player to keep their gained meter.
2) Fixed issue with main-menu-confirmation menu when the game was paused.
3) Enemy slowing factor when they overshoot the player is increased, so that the ships don't fly so wildly off the map.
4) Decreased damage to player from collisions in hard mode, from 20 to 15.

Version 1.2.4 Patch Notes
=========================
1) Changed logic around the inter-level warp effect to be more robust.
2) Modified the dialogue controller so that now, all dialogue in the game can be skipped by pressing "ESC" or "START".

Version 1.2.5 Patch Notes
========================
1) Fixed dialogues not playing correctly on final level after the player died.
2) The player's shield will now protect the player during the "shields up" animation.
3) Fixed a bug where a player could die while performing a barrel roll, when the player should be invincible during a roll.
4) The game can detect up to 6 unique joysticks, from 4. This helps alleviate issues around players with multiple controllers plugged in connecting via remote play.
5) Increased size of the Shotgun Frigate by 20%.
6) Changed spawn locations of the minibosses so they spawn closer to the top screen edge.
7) Added a warning flash on the screen to indicate when a kamikaze is incoming from the left or right screen edges.

Version 1.2.6 Patch Notes
========================
1) Fixed a bug where barrel rolling into a dying boss could cause the player to become invincible until the game was reloaded.
2) When an enemy that uses the Laser Beam weapon dies, the laser beam is immediately destroyed.

notes.title: The Last Archwing Major Update! V1.1.0
notes.content:
Major Update - V1.1.0!

One new fully voiced level featuring destructible asteroids! The new level is inserted where Level 4 used to be.

One new boss - the Missile Destroyer! You'll face it in Level 4, and later on as a mini-boss in some levels.

Four new enemies!
[olist]
[*] Kamikaze - Pursues the player while firing, tries to ram into player. Small fighter.
[*] Broadside Corvette - Moves horizontally or vertically on the screen firing from its sides.
[*] Minigun Corvette - Rapidly fires lasers at the player, followed by a short cooldown.
[*] Shotgun Frigate - Fires a burst of heavy lasers at the player, lots of health.
[/olist]

Full list of update details below!
[list]
[*] Barrel roll now shows an animation to show that the player is invulnerable.
[*] Rainbow capsule now has an animation to visually show that the effects are active (faster firing and invulnerability), the effect then starts to blink just before the time runs out.
[*] Super Death Wave now reflects shots back at enemies. These shots will damage them.
[*] If a player barrel roll's and touches a screen edge, the roll will end and the player will regain control of their ship, but the invincibility will continue at its normal length.
[*] All game levels have been adjusted to include the new enemies and the game has been re-balanced to accommodate the new enemies.
[*] Re-recorded dialogue for end of level 2, as it was far too verbose before. The scene plays out at a much faster pace now.
[*] Enemy movement and spawning has been altered to provide much greater variety. Ships now spawn in a greater variety of locations on the screen. New formations have been created for groups of ships. New movement types have been added to existing ships so they have more maneuvering options.
[*] Replaced the music of level 3 with a new song. Level 4 also has a unique track as well.
[*] Added subtext to Upgrade menu to help explain what each category does.
[*] Rainbow capsules can no longer drop during a boss fight.
[*] Reduced the amount of increased fire rate when picking up a rainbow capsule, the rate is faster at lower difficulties
[*] Rainbow capsules now also give you an extra shot, like the orange capsule does.
[*] Drastically decreased the difficulty of The Wizard's Battleship.
[*] Lowered Super Laser turret health on Red Destroyer (in level 10, previously level 9).
[*] Lowered collision damage in casual mode by 20%.
[*] Fixed various typos in dialogue text and cut a few lines of dialogue.
[*] Fixed a bug where some Battleship turrets were too high, and couldn't actually hit the player
[*] Fixed a bug where your super meter would reset to 0 when starting a new level.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.18 Live!
notes.content:
The latest patch is now live! 

Patch notes are below:

1) Made game fully compatible with ultra wide monitors.
2) Fixed bug where ship loses invincibility after picking up the rainbow capsule if they perform a barrell roll before the rainbow invincibility ends.
3) Added a prompt to explain how to skip dialogue.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.16 Live!
notes.content:
Version 1.0.16 Patch notes.

Overview:
   Added several new visual effects.
   Hard difficulty increased.
   Minor bug fixes.

1) Fixed bug with shields visually reforming even though the player is in a dying state.
2) Reforming shields no longer trigger nearby mines.
3) Fixed bug with player being flung offscreen if they died on top of an enemy just after a barrel roll.
4) Fixed ship explosion sound not having its volume adjusted by the master volume slider.
5) Added a parallax effect with the backgrounds in relation to the player.
6) Added a ripple special effect whenever the player dies, performs a super death wave, or a boss dies.
7) Small explosions now happen whenever a player laser strikes an enemy.
8) A sound effect plays whenever a player laser strikes enemy armor.
9) Normal Level 4 level is longer. Hard Level 4 is longer and more difficult.
10) Normal and Hard Level 9 now ends with a more powerful boss.
11) Hard Level 6, Upgraded the yellow boss ship. Added a green boss ship to the final wave, but compensated by slightly slowing down enemy spawn rates for the remainder of the wave. Made the boss stronger.
12) Hard Level 8, all midbosses are stronger, end boss is stronger.
13) Wingmates in level 1 will no longer barrel roll with you when they're about to die from the battleship.
